tool_mode: Codex built-in image_gen; one call per distinct board
intent: Generate morphology-first character-development sheets before face, material, color, or cinematic rendering decisions.
common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Starlight Intelligence robot morphology exploration sheet, pre-production silhouette gate. Create four genuinely different original robot character silhouettes for the named form family. Each candidate must have a different body architecture and locomotion or support idea while belonging to one coherent Starlight universe. Present four separate full-body candidates on a clean warm-white industrial-design sheet, arranged left to right with generous separation, consistent scale, and no cropping. Use premium feature-animation and AAA game character-development principles without imitating any franchise: immediate thumbnail silhouette, role-led function, one dominant shape, one supporting shape, one surprising functional detail. Render flat black and charcoal cut-paper silhouettes with only subtle mid-gray overlap planes. Preserve a softened rounded-square Starlight motif somewhere in each form. No eyes, face, mouth, text, labels, numbers, logos, weapons, capes, halos, decorative circuitry, glow, background scene, copied character silhouette, generic sci-fi armor, superhero stance, or ornamental AI nodes.
quality_gates: role readable at 96 pixels without color
no face or eye design yet
no decorative rendering used to hide weak form
founder selection before turnaround or polish

boards.prompt_delta: Full specialist, 6.5 to 7 heads tall, adult machine proportions. Explore a civic instrument, lantern scholar, folded architectural shell, and asymmetric analytical chassis. Calm neutral stance, restrained hands, visible but understated role utility. Avoid fashion-model anatomy, military armor, and heroic power poses.

Compact field specialist, 4 to 4.75 heads tall, short stable legs, broad expressive feet, compact torso with a functional tool bay, useful articulated hands. Explore rounded trapezoid torso, low cylindrical torso, folded ceramic shell, and modular pack-and-tool chassis. Capable adult machines, never children or toys.
boards.inspection: Pass for meaningful chassis diversity; iterate because internal component detail exceeds the silhouette-only constraint.

boards.prompt_delta: Chibi Academy guide, 2.6 to 3.2 heads tall, very short legs, large rounded-square head volume, oversized functional hands, simple stable feet, and reduced seams. Explore book-carrying tutor, workshop guide, observatory guide, and values steward. Warm through proportion and gesture, not smiles. Avoid baby onesies, plush-toy anatomy, and resemblance to Astro Bot, WALL-E, or Baymax.

Micro-avatar family for 32 to 96 pixel UI use. Create four head, bust, or emblem architectures built from only two or three dominant shapes: soft-square aperture, lantern housing, folded plane, and screenless witness form. Treat each as a physical icon silhouette, not a logo sheet. No full bodies and no tiny interior detail.

Guardian operator with broad low center of gravity, protective torso, small calm sensor head, planted stance, and visible shielding, audit, or containment function. Explore seated sentinel, arch-backed custodian, low quadruped guardian, and compact bipedal steward. Protective rather than intimidating. No weapons, riot-police language, spikes, or angry eye geometry.

Agile research and discovery scout. Explore light asymmetric biped, compact digitigrade courier, three-point rolling walker, and folding directional sensor chassis. Long spring geometry or visibly purposeful mobility, minimal cargo, and clear orientation toward a task. Avoid predatory insects, combat drones, random antenna forests, and speed-line clichés.

Clean biotech symbiote inspired by soft robotics and plant, manta, coral, and cephalopod engineering principles. Explore flexible standing membrane, low manta-like lab companion, branching photosensitive synthesist, and modular coral-like walker. Dry engineered surfaces, graceful load paths, distributed sensing. Avoid flesh, organs, veins, human anatomy, parasites, wet horror, and medical-device mimicry.

Swarm gestalt made from five to twelve small functional units. Explore docking tiles forming a temporary helper, relay walkers forming a bridge, seed-like research units creating a collective frame, and carrying units assembling a mobile archive. Each formation must have readable individual units and a clear collective task. Avoid particle clouds, orbital-node diagrams, anonymous dots, magical mist, and a single ungoverned hive-mind impression.

Non-humanoid role instrument. Explore an archive lantern on a mobile base, a folding verification press, a walking map table, and a compact mobile lens-and-sample laboratory. Function should create character without a face. Avoid generic glowing orbs, random control panels, fake text, and concealed humanoid bodies.

Original creature companion robots derived from function rather than literal animals. Explore a low quadruped field helper, a book-carrying bird-like guide, a seedling-legged reminder companion, and an aquatic-inspired hovering scout. Mechanical and ownable, with clear carrying or sensing utility. Avoid recognizable pet-robot products, Star Wars droids, cartoon animal faces, or franchise silhouettes.

Soft-shell care collaborator using textile, inflated lattice, silicone bumper, and compliant robotics principles. Explore seated listening form, mobile supportive workstation, soft-armed carrying assistant, and cocoon-like recovery guide. Safe contact and calm presence without pretending to be human. Avoid Baymax resemblance, inflatable mascot shapes, hospital branding, or sentimental smiles.

Modular transforming fabricator whose body reconfigures visibly around real tasks. Explore folding bench-to-biped, tool-cart-to-helper, stacked modules forming a tall reach mode, and compact carrier unfolding into a fabrication frame. Show plausible joints and mass distribution in a single neutral configuration per candidate. Avoid magical shape-shifting, Transformers resemblance, weapons, and impossible floating parts.

Aerial knowledge navigator for mapping, retrieval, and observatory work. Explore quiet ducted-lift ring, manta-wing glider, suspended archive spindle, and folding fan-like surveyor. Give every form credible lift or suspension logic and a calm non-military silhouette. Avoid quadcopter cliché, combat drone language, angel wings, halos, and impossible levitation without visible support logic.

Room-scale or architectural intelligence embodied as an environment rather than a person. Explore a mobile collaborative alcove, an archive doorway, a circular learning table that reorients to participants, and a modular wall-and-seat research station. Each must read as one agent with boundaries and human-accessible interaction points. Avoid generic sci-fi rooms, command centers, screens everywhere, temples, thrones, and surveillance architecture.
